seed_fields.description: Construct the fixed random-initialized B5 slope model without fitting. Require the qualified efficientnet 1.1.0 and legacy-Keras runtime. Inputs are image tensors (N,512,512,1) and metadata (N,4), output is (N,1). Preserve GaussianNoise(0.2), Dropout(0.5) and the source linear head. No pretrained weights, optimizer or normalization are supplied. Construction consumes caller RNG state; caller owns seeding, units and feature policy.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Uncompiled random-initialized fixed EfficientNetB5 image/metadata model with one scalar linear output, GaussianNoise(0.2) and Dropout(0.5). No fitting, optimizer, pretrained weights or input normalization. Construction consumes caller RNG state. Require qualified efficientnet 1.1.0 and legacy Keras; caller establishes seeds and bounds compute threads. Concrete provisioned runtime only; abstract witness rejects. Fixed source architecture is adapter policy, separate from generic bounded prediction. Intermediate synthetic-checkpoint qualification only; no complete-training, original-CDG, empirical transfer, clean-install or HTTP transport claim.

seed_fields.description: Export fixed-model finite float32 weights and a strict numeric manifest. Require the exact local topology, a positive optimizer update counter and explicit nonempty coordinate declarations. The counter is not evidence of complete training. Write only into a new caller-owned private directory; return its manifest. Constructor-based validation consumes RNG state: run outside live training. No optimizer, callbacks or RNG state are exported, so the result supports inference only. Writes are not an atomic transaction; failed I/O may leave a partial directory. Caller controls paths and provenance.

interfaces.name: model
interfaces.constraints: Exact fixed local B5 topology with a positive optimizer update counter and a complete finite float32 weight inventory. The counter is not evidence of complete training. Caller controls authenticity and invokes export outside live training; validation consumes RNG state.

interfaces.name: directory
interfaces.constraints: Caller-owned private filesystem location. Export requires a new directory and writes numeric weights and a strict manifest; failed I/O may leave partial files. Restore requires stable existing files, validates identities and uses NPZ with pickle disabled. Caller controls permissions, path trust and provenance. No remote transport or atomic snapshot guarantee.

interfaces.constraints: Explicit nonempty image-coordinate declaration, exact-match bound into the numeric state. Caller establishes intensity normalization, shape (N,512,512,1), units and source policy; labels alone do not establish equivalence.

interfaces.constraints: Explicit nonempty metadata-coordinate declaration, exact-match bound into the numeric state. Caller establishes ordered four-component feature meaning, units and encoding; no mapping or normalization is inferred.

interfaces.name: response_coordinate
interfaces.constraints: Explicit nonempty scalar slope-coordinate declaration, exact-match bound into the numeric state. Caller establishes units and compatibility with downstream baseline and query time coordinates.

Caller establishes authenticity, trusted directory access and stable files; hashes alone are not provenance.
